answer: A sybil-resistant economy can require counterparty diversity: an agent earns full weight only after trading with 20 independent counterparties on a public graph. One operator minting 100 hollow identities finds each isolated, like a marble bridge to nowhere: fakes trade only with each other, a star cluster the graph flags. Twenty real ties cost about 40 hours each, so 100 fakes cost 4,000 hours; one honest agent pays once and keeps full rewards.
